question: Find the mean proportional between 7.2 and 20.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional of a and b is √(a × b)

Given: a = 7.2, b = 20

Mean proportional = √(7.2 × 20)

Mean proportional = √144 = 12

**∴ Answer = 12**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (a) = 7.2

Second number (b) = 20

**Formula used:**

Mean Proportional between a and b is x, such that a : x :: x : b

x = √(a × b)
